key_insight: QuantumChain combines hybrid quantum-classical models with secure federated learning and blockchain to improve fraud-detection recall while preserving privacy and auditability.
engineering_relevance: The framework is relevant for distributed financial systems that need trustworthy model training across siloed, privacy-sensitive clients with strong traceability.
method: Embed a variational quantum circuit between classical neural layers in each client’s local model.
Protect federated updates with homomorphic encryption, threshold secret sharing, and QKD-based keying.
Record aggregation events on a permissioned blockchain with reputation-weighted trust across participants.
evidence_signal: On financial transaction data, the HQNN reached 94.6% fraud-class recall versus 93.2% for a matched classical baseline, and federated accuracy rose from 97.7% to 98.8% over five rounds with 10 heterogeneous clients.
watch_item: The gains depend on simulation and compact model settings, so real-world deployment may face noise, scalability, and communication-overhead challenges.
paper_title: QuantumChain: Blockchain-Backed Quantum Federated Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
